cool-paper.usage: Light page ground; sticky table and drawer headers.

sheet-white.usage: Light sidebar, controls, composer, callouts, notes, toasts.

deep-teal.usage: The one ink (light): counts, arrows, focus, selection borders, send, links.

deep-teal-shade.usage: Second accent stop (light); defined so collab-web's --accent-gradient resolves teal, but no shipped research-web surface paints the gradient.

teal-accent-wash.usage: Current strip box, badges, agent chip, emphasised button (light).

claim-tint.usage: Highlight on the sentence a claim check is about (light).

highlighter-exclude.usage: Exclude verdict band (light); orange-leaning, never pink.

soft-charcoal.usage: Dark page ground; never pure black.

sea-teal-shade.usage: Second accent stop (dark); same role as deep-teal-shade.

sea-teal-ink-on.usage: Text/icon on a sea-teal fill (send button, dark).

prisma-paper-dark.usage: Off-white card under the dimmed server PRISMA SVG (dark).

headline.purpose: Chat empty-state question; the largest step in the app.

title-document.purpose: Section headings inside a synthesized review.

title.purpose: Record title in the detail drawer; empty-state headings.

label.purpose: Strip labels, badges, verdict marks, metadata, margin notes.

label-small.purpose: Pending counts, agent chip, composer hint.

section-label.purpose: Uppercase sidebar section headings (Projects, Sessions) only.

command.purpose: Slash-command names on starter cards, in teal.

themes.default: light (main.tsx sets light before the stored preference is fetched; dark only when the server has dark saved)

shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Hairline lift under the composer only.

shadows.name: composer-focus
shadows.purpose: Composer focus-within, with a teal border.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Toasts and the mobile sidebar drawer.

shadows.name: backdrop
shadows.purpose: Scrim behind the mobile sidebar drawer.

focus.name: focus-ring
focus.purpose: All focusable elements; inset so scroll containers never clip it.

focus.name: focus-ring-frame

focus.name: citation-target

focus.purpose: The reference a citation link jumped to.

shapes.name: highlighter-stroke

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Baseline for every button and select: white sheet, strong hairline, 6px corners; teal wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--bg-raised, #fff); color: var(--fg, #16181a); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(15,118,110,0.06)); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Send Button
components.description: The composer's round teal send button; the only filled accent control.
components.html: <button class="ds-send" type="button" aria-label="Send"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3.714 3.048a.498.498 0 0 0-.683.627l2.843 7.627a2 2 0 0 1 0 1.396l-2.842 7.627a.498.498 0 0 0 .682.627l18-8.5a.5.5 0 0 0 0-.904z"/><path d="M6 12h16"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-send { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 34px; min-height: 34px; padding: 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #0f766e); color: var(--accent-fg, #fff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-send:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0f766e) 85%, var(--fg, #16181a)); } .ds-send:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-send[aria-disabled="true"] { opacity: 0.35; cursor: default; }

components.name: Header Tabs
components.description: Borderless muted tabs; the selected tab is a teal-bordered box on the selected wash.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); font-size: 14px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: none; color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(15,118,110,0.06)); } .ds-tab[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--selected, rgba(15,118,110,0.11)); border-color: var(--accent, #0f766e); color: var(--fg, #16181a); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: PRISMA Strip
components.description: Signature: five hairline boxed counts joined by teal arrows, in diagram order, with pending work beneath; the current stage is teal-bordered.
components.css: .ds-strip { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: 4px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-strip-box { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background: none; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; } .ds-strip-box:hover { background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(15,118,110,0.12)); } .ds-strip-box[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--accent, #0f766e); background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(15,118,110,0.12)); } .ds-strip-box:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-strip-n { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--rw-ink, #0f766e) 80%, var(--fg, #16181a)); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-strip-label { color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); font-size: 12px; } .ds-strip-pending { color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); font-size: 11px; } .ds-strip-pending-n { color: var(--rw-ink, #0f766e); font-weight: 600; } .ds-strip-arrow { flex: none; align-self: center; color: var(--rw-ink, #0f766e); }

components.name: Verdict Marks
components.description: Signature: verdicts as highlighter strokes on the lower part of the line, always icon + word.
components.html: Include Exclude Maybe
components.css: .ds-mark { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); position: relative; z-index: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 1px 6px 2px; color: var(--rw-hl-fg, #16181a); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 400; white-space: nowrap; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-mark::before { content: ""; position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 34% 0 0; border-radius: 2px 7px 3px 6px / 6px 3px 7px 2px; background: var(--ds-hl); } .ds-mark svg { flex: none; } .ds-mark-include { --ds-hl: var(--rw-hl-include, #bfe8c9); } .ds-mark-exclude { --ds-hl: var(--rw-hl-exclude, #f8c3b0); } .ds-mark-maybe { --ds-hl: var(--rw-hl-maybe, #f6e48a); }

components.name: Stage Badge
components.description: Where a record stands when no verdict is recorded: small teal-wash label; muted variant for duplicates.
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); display: inline-block; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(15,118,110,0.12)); color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0f766e) 70%, var(--fg, #16181a)); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-badge-muted { background: var(--selected, rgba(15,118,110,0.11)); color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); }

components.name: Filter Chips
components.description: Reading-list state filters: 32px pills with a muted tabular count; the checked chip is teal-bordered on the selected wash.
components.css: .ds-chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; } .ds-chip { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--bg-raised, #fff); color: var(--fg, #16181a); font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(15,118,110,0.06)); } .ds-chip[aria-checked="true"] { border-color: var(--accent, #0f766e); background: var(--selected, rgba(15,118,110,0.11)); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-count { margin-left: 2px; color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Recessed inset-paper field with a strong hairline; teal inset focus ring.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="Search title, author, DOI" aria-label="Search records">
components.css: .ds-search { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); width: 320px; max-width: 360px; min-height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--bg-inset, #eef0ee); color: var(--fg, #16181a); font-size: 14px; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); } .ds-search:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Composer
components.description: The primary control: a 12px-cornered raised sheet, borderless textarea over a toolbar, teal ring on focus-within.
components.html: ModelThinking: off
components.css: .ds-composer { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: 560px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: var(--radius-xl, 12px); background: var(--bg-raised, #fff); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card, 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)), 0 6px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #16181a) 7%, transparent); transition: border-color 150ms, box-shadow 150ms; } .ds-composer:focus-within { border-color: var(--accent, #0f766e); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-muted, rgba(15,118,110,0.12)), 0 6px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--fg, #16181a) 7%, transparent); } .ds-composer-input { min-height: calc(2lh + 16px); resize: none; padding: 12px 14px 4px; border: 0; background: none; color: var(--fg, #16181a); font: inherit; font-size: 15px; outline: none; } .ds-composer-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; padding: 4px 8px 8px; } .ds-pick { padding: 4px 6px; color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); font-size: 12.5px; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); } .ds-pick:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(15,118,110,0.06)); color: var(--fg, #16181a); } .ds-composer-send { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 34px; min-height: 34px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #0f766e); color: var(--accent-fg, #fff); cursor: pointer; } .ds-composer-send:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0f766e) 85%, var(--fg, #16181a)); }

components.name: Margin Note
components.description: Signature: a claim-check note in the review margin, tied to its line by a 1px teal connector.
components.html: “Reported accuracy gains over a single-model”
components.css: .ds-margin { position: relative; padding-left: 32px; width: 210px; } .ds-note { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); position: relative; padding: 8px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 4px); background: var(--bg-raised, #fff); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.45; color: var(--fg, #16181a); } .ds-note::before { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 100%; width: 26px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rw-ink, #0f766e); } .ds-note-quote { margin: 0 0 6px; color: var(--fg-muted, #545a5f); } .ds-note-btn { font: inherit; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--bg-raised, #fff); color: var(--fg, #16181a); cursor: pointer; } .ds-note-btn:hover { background: var(--hover, rgba(15,118,110,0.06)); } .ds-note-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Next-step Callout
components.description: The Reading list's next action: hairline box, count in teal ink, emphasised teal-wash button.
components.html: 3 not screened
components.css: .ds-next { font-family: var(--font-ui, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, rgba(0,0,0,0.16)); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--bg-raised, #fff); color: var(--fg, #16181a); font-size: 14px; } .ds-next-n { color: var(--rw-ink, #0f766e); font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-next-btn { font: inherit; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--accent-muted, rgba(15,118,110,0.12)); color: var(--fg, #16181a); font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-next-btn:hover { background: var(--selected, rgba(15,118,110,0.11)); } .ds-next-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0f766e); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview:
research web is a working desk for a long screening session, and the review's own paperwork is its visual language. The PRISMA flow diagram a researcher will print in her manuscript is redrawn in the header as five hairline boxes joined by thin arrows; her highlighter marks become the verdict marks in the Reading list; a selected sentence in a review gets a margin note tied back to the line by a hairline connector. Everything else (sidebar, tabs, transcript, composer) stays quiet, flat and conventional so those three devices carry the identity.

The ground is cool paper (light, the default) or soft charcoal (dark), never pure black. One ink, deep teal, carries structure, counts, focus, selection and the agent's controls; there is no second accent and no gradient in use. Colour beyond teal is reserved for meaning: three highlighter bands for verdicts and the status trio for real system state. Density is Operate-grade: 14px body, 4–12px steps, hairline borders, small corners, tabular figures wherever counts are compared.

The world is built as an override layer: `theme.css` replaces every colour and radius token of collab-web's upstream `tokens.css` (whose cyan-to-pink accent and pure-black chassis are fully overridden) so the inherited transcript and composer read in the same world without editing upstream files.
keyCharacteristics: PRISMA flow notation as chrome: boxed counts, 1px borders, 4px corners, arrow connectors.
One deep-teal ink (light #0f766e / dark #5fb3a8) for structure, counts, focus and the agent.
Verdicts as highlighter strokes: band + lucide icon + word, never colour alone.
Tabular numerals on every count, badge, table and status line.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines; shadow only on the composer and floating layers.
Light by default for daylight reading; soft charcoal dark theme with a dimmed paper card for the PRISMA figure.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: Teal is the only accent. Structure, counts, focus and the agent share it; no second brand hue, no gradient, no pink or magenta anywhere.

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Green, vermilion and yellow mean include, exclude and maybe, and nothing else. Every band carries its lucide icon (Check, X, CircleHelp) and the word.

rules.name: The Override Layer Rule
rules.body: Raw colour values live only in `theme.css`; every other stylesheet uses variables. Change the two light blocks together.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Every number a researcher compares down a column or across the strip uses tabular figures (`.rw-count`, strip, badges, table, status, chips). Review prose keeps proportional figures.

rules.name: The Weight-Not-Size Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is 600 weight at an existing size; no step above 20px exists.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Boxes, cards, notes, callouts and the PRISMA card take a 1px border and no shadow. Only the composer and floating layers lift.

dos: **Do** use the deep teal (light #0f766e, dark #5fb3a8) as the only accent, for structure, counts, focus, selection and the agent's controls.
**Do** draw boxes the PRISMA way: 1px `hairline-strong` border, 4–6px corners, no shadow.
**Do** render every verdict with the highlighter band, its lucide icon and the word.
**Do** set every compared count in tabular figures.
**Do** put raw colour values only in `theme.css`, overriding collab-web's tokens rather than editing them, and change both light blocks together.
**Do** keep focus visible as a 2px teal outline, inset by 2px inside scroll containers.
**Do** keep the dark ground a soft charcoal (#141517) and set the PRISMA figure on its dimmed paper card in dark mode.
donts: **Don't** use pink or magenta anywhere: no accent, gradient, mark or icon in that hue.
**Don't** let a highlighter colour stand alone, or use green, vermilion or yellow for anything but a verdict.
**Don't** add shadows to boxes, cards or notes; only the composer and floating layers lift.
**Don't** mark state with a grey fill; hover and selection use teal washes.
